title: Property & Revenue
summary: Advice and representation across title verification, partition and property disputes, declaration and injunction suits, registration and revenue matters, due diligence and property-related legal proceedings.

prepare: Bring sale or settlement deeds, the encumbrance certificate, patta and chitta extracts, and any notice or court order connected with the property.
